# (lab/fmp4/PIN.md) by lab/fmp4/gen_timeline_oracle.py, cross-checked against the
# walk_mp4.py fragment resolution. An init elst shifts ffprobe timestamps;
# stored dts/cts are media time (ffprobe + media_time). pts == dts is asserted,
# so each pkt's cts equals its dts. Product tests replay this file and never
# spawn ffprobe.
# present elst <u64|none> seg_dur <u64|none> ffprobe_first_pts <i64> priming <u64|none>
# frag <mfhd seq> tfdt <u64|none> first <dts> end <dts> packets <n>
# pkt <pos> <size> <dts> <cts>
